subject: QueryFlow partnership: lightweight trace & prompt shim
messages:
From: Samir Patel <sam@queryflow.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex@queryflow.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QueryFlow partnership: lightweight trace & prompt shim

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. QueryFlow has been building a set of developer-facing tooling for prompt observability and trace stitching (we surface token-level spans and prompt provenance back to LLM runtime calls). A few enterprise customers have asked us to natively integrate with their inference providers, and Redwood was at the top of that list.

We put together a short draft (attached) that outlines a tiny SDK shim plus a tracing plugin which: 1) emits Redwood-compatible trace headers, 2) optionally attaches prompt attribution metadata, and 3) exposes a small middleware for LangChain/LlamaIndex so ISV customers can enable tracing with a single line.

Asks:
- Can we get a sandbox API key and a test endpoint for Redwood Hosted and Dedicated?
- Any constraints around the trace header format and PII filtering we should be aware of?
- Would Redwood be open to a co-marketing announcement if we ship a certified integration?

I've attached the spec and a mutual action plan MVP. Happy to demo this week.

Attached: QueryFlow-Redwood-ProtoSpec-v1.pdf, QF-MutualActionPlan.xlsx

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, QueryFlow
sam@queryflow.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <sam@queryflow.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 12:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QueryFlow partnership: lightweight trace & prompt shim

Samir —

Really appreciate the spec and the plan. We're interested. A few quick notes and proposed next steps:

1) Sandbox access: I can provision a Redwood sandbox key scoped to a trace-only role (no billing) — will send via our secrets pipeline.
2) Trace headers: we prefer a header namespace of X-Redwood-Trace-V1 and a short JSON payload (max 4KB). For PII, please make sure prompt text is redacted unless the customer explicitly opts-in. Our security team requires a config flag to opt-in to full prompt capture.
3) Integration surface: LangChain and LlamaIndex middleware looks good; we prefer the shim to be opt-in at the runtime instantiation level rather than altering the host library.
4) Certification: co-marketing is possible — we'll need a short tech review and a joint integration playbook from your side.

Action items I propose:
- Redwood: send sandbox key and a short acceptance criteria doc by EOD Wednesday.
- QueryFlow: push a small PR that wires your shim into a LangChain example and point it at the sandbox by next Monday.
- Schedule a 30-min kickoff to align on auth, SSO, and data residency (I propose Thu 14:00 PT).

Looping Vanessa for commercial/partner motion and Kim for security/compliance gating.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
